verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents Role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grained control over who can access which resources, backed by organizations for sharing collections/environments securely, and SAML 2.0 SSO integration for identity management. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of RBAC granularity in practice and more detail on specific role definitions (e.g., viewer vs editor specifics).
